name: Media Word Filter
description: Media Word Filter companion for Jellyfin Web. mute.v2 audio tiers + view skip/block with details-page prefs.
overview: Details-page filter prefs (blasphemy, profanity T1–T3, per-label skip/block). Audio uses video.muted; view_filter skip seeks and block draws overlays.
changelog: mute.v2 support: details prefs for blasphemy/profanity tiers and per-matched skip/block/off; playback skip seek + block overlays.
